successors.name: Sokoto Caliphate
successors.text: Nupeland between the Niger and Kaduna rivers (the page gives no outline; a disc at Bida stands for it)

ledger.x: 1835: the Nupe Kingdom becomes the Nupe Emirate under Gwandu.
1835: the Nupe Kingdom ends; the Nupe Emirate (1835-1901) is the Sokoto emirate of Bida, which "British [Niger Company] troops finally took... and established a puppet ruler" in 1897.

wars.name: Fulani conquest of Nupe
wars.outcome: The Fulani gained power across Northern Nigeria in Ma'azu's time and Nupe came under Gwandu after his death in 1818; the page dates the emirate to 1835.

certainty.note: No frontier on the page; the kingdom is a river-basin core.
